name: Seletar Hash House Harriers
summary: North-east social hash kennel — guest-friendly trails and circle culture without country-club fees.
body: Seletar Hash is one of Singapore’s regular Hash House Harriers kennels, with a north-east trail footprint that suits households living away from the Bukit Timah club belt. Like other hashes, the format is show-up running or walking plus an after-trail circle — fitness optional, cash run fees typical, humour not for everyone. Reddit newcomer threads that recommend hashing as a low-fee weekly ritual apply here: try Seletar and Lion City before declaring a home pack. Check the kennel’s Facebook or site for the week’s start point (hashes move), bring trail shoes and water, and stay for the circle once so names stick.
membershipNotes: Pay-per-run culture; bring cash. Confirm live run fees and start locations with the kennel.
